grammar_title: 被动语态复习(各时态被动 + 现在进行被动 + 现在完成被动)
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 4 Grammar in Use:Passives(review + present continuous passive + present perfect passive)。句子地道、习俗/成人礼主题,时间状语/语境定时态,被动形式唯一成立(干扰项为主动或错时态被动)。

points.point: 各时态被动(一般现在/过去/将来 + 情态被动)
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动:一般现在 is/are done、一般过去 was/were done、一般将来 will be done、情态 can/must/should be done。由时间状语或语境判断时态。

points.point: 现在进行时被动(is/are being done)
points.overview: 表示'此刻正被……'时用现在进行被动:am/is/are + being + 过去分词。常与 now、at the moment、right now 等连用。

points.point: 现在完成时被动(has/have been done)
points.overview: 表示动作已完成并影响现在时用现在完成被动:has/have + been + 过去分词。常与 already、just、so far、recently 等连用;主语为动作承受者。

questions.stem: "In some Indian families, the sacred thread ceremony ____ when a boy grows up."
questions.explanation: ceremony 是动作承受者、一般现在的习俗 → is performed。

questions.stem: "In ancient China, a hair-pinning ceremony ____ for a girl when she turned fifteen."
questions.explanation: ancient China 指过去、ceremony 被举行 → was held。

questions.stem: "Next week a coming-of-age ceremony ____ at our school for the senior students."
questions.explanation: Next week 指将来、ceremony 被举办 → will be held。

questions.stem: "The capping ceremony ____ only by respected elders in old times."
questions.explanation: 情态被动:只能被长辈来举行 → could be performed。

questions.stem: "During the ceremony, three strands of thread ____ to the boy as a gift."
questions.explanation: thread 是被给予者、一般现在习俗 → are given。

questions.stem: "Last year the festival ____ in the school gymnasium for the whole town."
questions.explanation: Last year 指过去、festival 被庆祝 → was celebrated。

questions.stem: "Traditional clothes ____ before the ceremony begins tomorrow."
questions.explanation: 情态被动:衣服必须被租好 → must be rented。

questions.stem: "In Germany, the youth celebration ____ 'Jugendfeier' by local people."
questions.explanation: celebration 被称为、一般现在 → is called。

questions.stem: "In the past, girls ____ household skills to prepare for marriage."
questions.explanation: In the past 指过去、girls 是被教者 → were taught。

questions.stem: "At next month's homecoming, a king and queen ____ from the upper-level students."
questions.explanation: next month 指将来、king and queen 被选拔 → will be selected。

questions.stem: "The whole occasion ____ with a graceful bow to the parents every year."
questions.explanation: every year 指一般现在、occasion 被以鞠躬结束 → is ended。

questions.stem: "The parade ____ through the main streets of the town yesterday afternoon."
questions.explanation: yesterday 指过去、parade 被举办 → was staged。

questions.stem: "At the ceremony, the meaning of each ritual ____ clearly to the young guests."
questions.explanation: meaning 被解释、一般现在 → is explained。

questions.stem: "In Finland, every new mother ____ a baby box by the government each year."
questions.explanation: 每年发生的习俗、mother 被给予 → is given。

questions.stem: "The Coming-of-Age Day ____ on the third Monday of May every year."
questions.explanation: every year、Day 被庆祝 → is observed。

questions.stem: "In a hospital in Brazil, the gifts ____ to every visitor after the baby was born."
questions.explanation: was born 表过去、gifts 被赠送 → were given。

questions.stem: "A king and queen ____ at the next homecoming dance, as is the custom."
questions.explanation: next、是承受者 → will be elected。

questions.stem: "In Jamaica, a tree ____ on that spot by the parents many years ago."
questions.explanation: years ago 指过去、tree 被栽种 → was planted。

questions.stem: "At the dance, popular music ____ by a DJ or a live band each Friday."
questions.explanation: each Friday、music 被演奏 → is played。

questions.stem: "Long ago the capping ceremony ____ for boys when they reached twenty."
questions.explanation: Long ago 指过去、ceremony 被举行 → was performed。

questions.stem: "Look! The Full Moon ceremony ____ in the hall right now."
questions.explanation: right now + 是承受者 → 现在进行被动 is being held。

questions.stem: "Be quiet, please. The sacred thread ____ around the boy's wrist at the moment."
questions.explanation: at the moment + 线被系 → is being tied。

questions.stem: "Listen! A speech of encouragement ____ to the young adults right now."
questions.explanation: right now + speech 被发表 → is being given。

questions.stem: "The hall is noisy because the parade floats ____ at this moment."
questions.explanation: at this moment + floats 被装饰 → are being decorated。

questions.stem: "Don't go in now — traditional clothes ____ on the young dancers."
questions.explanation: 正在进行、clothes 被穿上 → are being put。

questions.stem: "Look at the stage! The Coming-of-Age Day ceremony ____ in Seoul now."
questions.explanation: now + 现场 → 现在进行被动 is being celebrated。

questions.stem: "We can't enter — the gymnasium ____ for tonight's homecoming dance right now."
questions.explanation: right now + 场馆被布置 → is being prepared。

questions.stem: "Quiet, everyone! The king and queen ____ on the stage at this very moment."
questions.explanation: at this very moment + 被选 → are being elected。

questions.stem: "The whole town is busy: a homecoming parade ____ down Main Street now."
questions.explanation: now + parade 被举办 → is being staged。

questions.stem: "Please wait outside. The ceremony hall ____ with flowers for the occasion now."
questions.explanation: now + 大厅被布置 → is being filled。

questions.stem: "Look over there! Old photos ____ to the returning alumni at the moment."
questions.explanation: at the moment + 照片被展示 → are being shown。

questions.stem: "Listen carefully — the rules of the ceremony ____ to the guests right now."
questions.explanation: right now + 规则被宣读 → are being read。

questions.stem: "Don't move the table; the traditional food ____ for the festival at the moment."
questions.explanation: at the moment + 食物被准备 → is being prepared。

questions.stem: "The street is crowded because the marching band ____ for the parade now."
questions.explanation: now + 乐队被组织 → is being organised。

questions.stem: "Shh! A graceful bow to the parents ____ on the stage at this moment."
questions.explanation: at this moment + 鞠躬被表演 → is being performed。

questions.stem: "Look! The young dancers' costumes ____ backstage right now."
questions.explanation: right now + 服装被更换 → are being changed。

questions.stem: "Wait a minute — the Homecoming Court ____ for the photo at the moment."
questions.explanation: at the moment + 队伍被安排 → is being arranged。

questions.stem: "You can hear the noise because the stage ____ for the celebration right now."
questions.explanation: right now + 舞台被搭建 → is being built。

questions.stem: "Look! Gifts ____ to each visitor as the baby's ceremony goes on now."
questions.explanation: now + 礼物被递出 → are being handed。

questions.stem: "Keep your voice down — the elders' speeches ____ to the young guests now."
questions.explanation: now + 演讲被翻译 → are being translated。

questions.stem: "The sacred thread ____ around the boy's wrist, so the ritual is now complete."
questions.explanation: 已完成、thread 被系 → has been tied。

questions.stem: "The ceremony hall ____ already ____ with flowers, so we can go in."
questions.explanation: already + 大厅被布置好 → has been decorated。

questions.stem: "So far, three coming-of-age ceremonies ____ at our school this term."
questions.explanation: So far + 是承受者 → 现在完成被动 have been held。

questions.stem: "The traditional clothes ____ just ____, so the dancers can put them on."
questions.explanation: just + 衣服被熨好 → have been ironed。

questions.stem: "The king and queen ____ already ____, and now they are receiving flowers."
questions.explanation: already + 被选出 → have been elected。

questions.stem: "Recently, many old traditions ____ back to life in our town."
questions.explanation: Recently + 传统被恢复 → have been brought。

questions.stem: "The invitations to the homecoming dance ____ already ____ to every student."
questions.explanation: already + 请柬被寄出 → have been sent。

questions.stem: "Up to now, the meaning of the ritual ____ to all the foreign guests."
questions.explanation: Up to now + 含义被解释 → has been explained。

questions.stem: "A tree ____ just ____ on that spot to mark the baby's birth."
questions.explanation: just + 树被栽 → has been planted。

questions.stem: "The whole parade route ____ already ____ for tomorrow's celebration."
questions.explanation: already + 路线被规划 → has been planned。

questions.stem: "So far this week, two speeches of encouragement ____ to the young adults."
questions.explanation: So far + 演讲被发表 → have been given。

questions.stem: "The gymnasium ____ just ____ for the homecoming dance, so it looks lovely."
questions.explanation: just + 场馆被打扫 → has been cleaned。

questions.stem: "Many gifts ____ already ____ to the visitors at the baby's ceremony."
questions.explanation: already + 礼物被分发 → have been handed。

questions.stem: "The bow to the parents ____ just ____, and the ceremony is now over."
questions.explanation: just + 鞠躬被完成 → has been performed。

questions.stem: "This year, the day ____ chosen as a national holiday for young people."
questions.explanation: This year + 被定为节日 → has been (chosen)。

questions.stem: "All the traditional food ____ already ____ for the festival guests."
questions.explanation: already + 食物被准备好 → has been prepared。

questions.stem: "The stage ____ just ____, so the celebration can begin at once."
questions.explanation: just + 舞台被搭好 → has been built。

questions.stem: "Over the years, this custom ____ down from one generation to the next."
questions.explanation: Over the years + 习俗被传承 → has been passed。

questions.stem: "The names of the Homecoming Court ____ already ____ on the school website."
questions.explanation: already + 名单被公布 → have been posted。

questions.stem: "Up to now, every part of the ceremony ____ carefully by the elders."
questions.explanation: Up to now + 各环节被安排 → has been arranged。
